title: 蘇花改觀音隧道~Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel
focus: 弱帶、多工作面與長隧道系統聯動~Weak zones, multiple headings and linked tunnel systems
summary: 公路機關列觀音隧道約7.9公里、雙孔單向配置，並記錄利用舊北迴隧道增加施工工作面。本課從這項既有設施再利用出發，分析地質弱帶、地下水、控制網、施工交通與通風設備介面；貫通和2020年蘇花改全線通車是不同事件，課程不把兩者混為一談。~The highway authority describes Guanyin as approximately 7.9 km with twin directional bores and reuse of an old railway tunnel to create working faces. This course follows weak ground, groundwater, survey, construction traffic and ventilation interfaces. Breakthrough and the 2020 opening of the full Suhua improvement corridor remain distinct events.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 觀音與鄰接谷風及短橋形成連續服務路廊，教材分開單隧道里程與系統連續行車範圍。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~Guanyin and neighbouring tunnel-bridge links form a continuous corridor; distinguish one tunnel length from the operational route. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=18.8 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=18.8 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為20.68 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=18.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=18.8 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 20.68 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以相同起訖點核對觀音、橋及鄰洞的範圍。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Reconcile Guanyin, bridge and adjacent-bore scope between fixed endpoints. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只看單洞長度可能漏掉鄰洞事故對交通及救援的影響。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~Single-bore length misses adjacent-tunnel effects on traffic and rescue. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：以相同起訖點核對觀音、橋及鄰洞的範圍。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile Guanyin, bridge and adjacent-bore scope between fixed endpoints. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新~Fault connectivity and forecast updating
units.mechanism: 觀音公開論壇討論地質弱帶，本課研究裂隙填充、產狀和掌子面水量如何共同修正預報。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。~Official technical forums discuss weak zones; combine infill, orientation and face inflow to update forecasts. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
units.model: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=3e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=370 m²。Q=k i A=0.002331 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0025641 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=3e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=370 m². Q=k i A=0.002331 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0025641 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 按工作面和里程整理弱帶類型與後續支護反應。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Organise weak-zone types and support response by face and chainage. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 同一弱帶名稱可能含不同水理連通性，不能只套固定參數。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。~One weak-zone label can hide differing connectivity and cannot dictate fixed parameters. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.
units.misconception: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。~Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
units.practice: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：按工作面和里程整理弱帶類型與後續支護反應。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。~For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Organise weak-zone types and support response by face and chainage. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

units.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓~Piezometric head and lining pressure
units.mechanism: 舊鐵路坑與新道路孔可能形成水力聯繫，教材檢查增加工作面後出水重新分配的假想情境。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。~Old railway galleries and new road bores may interact hydraulically; test hypothetical flow redistribution after new access opens. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=100 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=981 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1079.1 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=100 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=981 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1079.1 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 同步記錄舊坑及新孔水頭與出流變化。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Synchronise old-gallery and new-bore head and flow changes. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 新孔水少可能只是舊坑先截水，並非地層原本乾燥。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。~Low new-bore flow may reflect interception by the old gallery rather than dry ground. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。~No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
units.practice: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：同步記錄舊坑及新孔水頭與出流變化。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。~For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise old-gallery and new-bore head and flow changes. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

units.anchor: 支護安裝時點~Support activation time
units.title: 支護啟動與變形容量~Support activation and deformation capacity
units.mechanism: 多工作面通過弱帶的支護時序不同，教材比較相同地質但不同封閉時間的收斂荷重。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。~Different headings cross weak zones with different closure timing; compare loads and convergence within the same geology. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
units.model: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=47 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。F=ku=376 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為413.6 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=47 kN/mm; movement=8 mm. F=ku=376 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 413.6 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將封閉時間標在各工作面的同齡期曲線。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Mark closure time on age-aligned histories from each heading. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 按施工日期直接比較會混入不同開挖齡期。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。~Comparing calendar dates directly mixes different excavation ages. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.
units.misconception: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。~Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
units.practice: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將封閉時間標在各工作面的同齡期曲線。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。~For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Mark closure time on age-aligned histories from each heading. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

units.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸~Shared access and transport bottlenecks
units.mechanism: 既有鐵路坑增設工作面也帶來共享通道瓶頸，觀音教材用完整循環檢查材料與出渣交會。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。~Reusing a railway gallery adds headings but also shared-access bottlenecks; examine complete material and spoil cycles. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
units.model: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=37 t；往返週期=34 min。C=N payload 60/T=261.176 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為237.433 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=37 t; cycle=34 min. C=N payload 60/T=261.176 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 237.433 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 對照各面出渣需求、交會等待及卸料能力。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare heading demand, passing queues and unloading capacity. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 工作面數增加不能直接倍增每日總進尺。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。~More headings do not directly multiply daily total advance. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.
units.misconception: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。~Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
units.practice: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：對照各面出渣需求、交會等待及卸料能力。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。~For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Compare heading demand, passing queues and unloading capacity. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

units.title: 控制網與貫通誤差~Control network and breakthrough error
units.mechanism: 多面貫通需把舊坑坐標傳入新孔，教材分析歷史基準與現代控制網轉換的誤差。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。~Multiple breakthroughs require transfer from old-gallery coordinates into new bores, including historical-to-modern datum errors. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
units.model: 原創教學假設：控制長度=5040 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0610865 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0671952 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: control length=5040 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0610865 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0671952 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 用新地表控制獨立覆核舊坑基準與方向。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Independently recheck old-gallery references and orientation from new surface control. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 舊坑幾何吻合不證明其坐標可直接用於新道路孔。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。~Agreement with old-gallery geometry does not validate direct coordinate reuse. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.
units.misconception: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。~Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
units.practice: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：用新地表控制獨立覆核舊坑基準與方向。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。~For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Independently recheck old-gallery references and orientation from new surface control. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

units.title: 內部樓板與荷載路徑~Internal decks and load paths
units.mechanism: 觀音通風機房及管道情境中的隔板是設備風道構件，不是雙層道路樓板，荷載功能必須先辨認。雙層公路的樓板、或隧道內設備隔板，都把局部荷載傳給支承，但兩者功能與設計作用並不相同。簡支條帶可估計均載彎矩，集中輪載、剪力、疲勞與火災降強度必須另驗；幾何空間分層不能取代結構邊界的確認。~A ventilation-room or duct partition is an equipment-airway component, not a double-deck roadway slab; establish its function first. A double-deck road slab and an equipment partition both transfer local loads to supports but serve different functions and design actions. A simply supported strip estimates uniform-load bending. Concentrated wheel loads, shear, fatigue and fire-reduced strength require separate checks; dividing space geometrically does not establish the actual structural restraints.
units.model: 原創教學假設：單位長載重=37 kN/m；跨距=3.9 m。M=qL²/8=70.3462 kN·m。僅把跨距增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為85.119 kN·m。邊界：均載簡支單向條帶，連續框架及板效應另驗；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: line load=37 kN/m; span=3.9 m. M=qL²/8=70.3462 kN·m. Increasing only span by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.119 kN·m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded simply supported strip; frame continuity and plate action need separate checks. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 核對隔板支承、風壓及維修荷載，不套車輪荷載。核對支承位置、施工接縫及荷載分布，將實測撓度與分階段模型比較，分辨整體變形與支承滑移。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check partition supports, air pressure and maintenance loading without substituting wheel loads. Check support positions, construction joints and load distribution; compare measured deflection with staged models to distinguish member bending from support slip. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 將風道隔板當行車樓板會錯置荷載與檢核目的。把隔板誤當行車樓板會使用錯誤荷載，反之漏掉交通集中荷載則低估局部彎剪與疲勞。~Treating an airway partition as a roadway deck misassigns loads and checks. Mistaking a partition for a roadway deck applies the wrong actions, while omitting concentrated traffic load underestimates local bending, shear and fatigue.
units.misconception: 只要空間分成兩層就可以採用相同的樓板荷載。~Any space divided into two levels can use the same deck loading.
units.practice: 本案「樓板條帶受彎」的交付需回答：核對隔板支承、風壓及維修荷載，不套車輪荷載。交付時明示樓板用途、支承及各施工階段，讓建築淨空、設備配置及結構假設在同一版本中核對。~For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the deck-strip bending handover must address the following evidence: Check partition supports, air pressure and maintenance loading without substituting wheel loads. State deck function, supports and construction stages at handover so clearance, equipment layout and structural assumptions can be reconciled in one revision.

units.anchor: 風道摩擦壓損~Duct friction loss
units.title: 通風網路與壓力損失~Ventilation network and pressure loss
units.mechanism: 觀音與相鄰設施的通風控制需保留門位和車流邊界，教材分析設備維修時支路阻力重分配。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。~Ventilation control must retain door and traffic boundaries across linked facilities; examine resistance redistribution during maintenance. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
units.model: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1180 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.7 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=60.5783 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為73.2997 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1180 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.7 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=60.5783 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 73.2997 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 同步比較風門狀態、機房壓差與孔內風速。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare damper state, plant-room pressure and in-bore velocity simultaneously. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 機房風量正常可能伴隨風道漏風而使道路區效果不足。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。~Normal plant flow can coexist with duct leakage and inadequate roadway flow. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.
units.misconception: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。~Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同步比較風門狀態、機房壓差與孔內風速。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。~For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Compare damper state, plant-room pressure and in-bore velocity simultaneously. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

units.anchor: 所需疏散時間~Required evacuation time
units.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性~Evacuation time and zone availability
units.mechanism: 連續長隧道路廊的救援需確認鄰孔及出口狀態，教材把最短橫通道距離和完整轉移路徑分開。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。~A linked long-tunnel corridor needs receiving-bore and exit checks; separate nearest passage distance from the complete transfer route. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
units.model: 原創教學假設：前置時間=114 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=564 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為609 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=114 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=564 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 609 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 走查橫通道後續路徑及實際門位，保留施工封閉。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Walk the route beyond each passage and record actual doors and closures. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 到達橫通道並不等於已抵達可持續停留的安全位置。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。~Reaching a cross passage does not establish arrival at a sustainable safe location. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.
units.misconception: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。~Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
units.practice: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：走查橫通道後續路徑及實際門位，保留施工封閉。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。~For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Walk the route beyond each passage and record actual doors and closures. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 舊坑再利用與新機電資料須保留不同來源和狀態，教材檢查舊圖與竣工圖的里程對照。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Reuse and new systems require distinct provenance and status; check chainage mapping between old and as-built drawings. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=117 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.3248 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為84.9573 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=117 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.3248 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 84.9573 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 抽查現場設備可否回溯到新孔里程與舊坑介面。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Trace field assets to new-bore chainage and old-gallery interfaces. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 舊新里程混用會把漏水和設備工單派到不同實體位置。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~Mixed old and new chainages assign leak and equipment work orders to different physical locations. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查現場設備可否回溯到新孔里程與舊坑介面。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace field assets to new-bore chainage and old-gallery interfaces. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，再獨立計算「控制網與貫通誤差」。原創教學假設：滲透係數=3e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=370 m²。Q=k i A=0.002331 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0025641 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：控制長度=5040 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0610865 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0671952 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate fault connectivity and forecast updating, then independently calculate control network and breakthrough error. Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=3e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=370 m². Q=k i A=0.002331 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0025641 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: control length=5040 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0610865 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0671952 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 2016 年公開記錄：公路機關記錄觀音隧道貫通里程碑。公路機關列觀音隧道約7.9公里、雙孔單向配置，並記錄利用舊北迴隧道增加施工工作面。本課從這項既有設施再利用出發，分析地質弱帶、地下水、控制網、施工交通與通風設備介面；貫通和2020年蘇花改全線通車是不同事件，課程不把兩者混為一談。本課把「弱帶、多工作面與長隧道系統聯動」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 2016: The highway authority records a Guanyin Tunnel breakthrough milestone. The highway authority describes Guanyin as approximately 7.9 km with twin directional bores and reuse of an old railway tunnel to create working faces. This course follows weak ground, groundwater, survey, construction traffic and ventilation interfaces. Breakthrough and the 2020 opening of the full Suhua improvement corridor remain distinct events. The course treats weak zones, multiple headings and linked tunnel systems as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 approximately 7.9 km，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about approximately 7.9 km; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2016 年事件：公路機關記錄觀音隧道貫通里程碑。~2016 event: The highway authority records a Guanyin Tunnel breakthrough milestone.

教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=18.8 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=18.8 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=18.8 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 18.8 min; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「破碎帶連通性」：滲透係數=3e-06 m/s，其餘輸入依單元，結果=0.002331 m³/s；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching fault-zone connectivity: conductivity=3e-06 m/s, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 0.002331 m³/s; not measured or accepted project data.
教學「出渣運輸節拍」：車輛數=4 個，其餘輸入依單元，結果=261.176 t/h；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching muck-transport cycle: vehicles=4 count, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 261.176 t/h; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「方向角誤差」：控制長度=5040 m，其餘輸入依單元，結果=0.0610865 m；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching orientation error: control length=5040 m, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 0.0610865 m; not measured or accepted project data.
